trajectory_summary: The call opens with mild friction over lead timing, dips briefly into surfaced skepticism about a prior unconvincing design, then builds steadily once the customer starts reading his actual usage data — ending in a smoothly booked appointment with full contact re-verification. Energy clearly built across the call, driven less by rep technique and more by the customer's own cooperative effort pulling up his account. The rep executed the mechanics cleanly (verify, credit qualifier, bill/usage capture, booking) but left the emotional/competitive threads (why the prior design failed, the bill pain itself) unexplored.
